claims: A focused test run can pass as the full self-test when the gate runs without the lock — `scripts/agent-quality-gate.test.sh:601`: the guard only refuses a focus when `AGENT_QUALITY_GATE_LOCK_HELD` or `GITHUB_ACTIONS` is set; with `--no-lock` or `AGENT_QUALITY_GATE_LOCK=0` lock acquisition returns early (`scripts/agent-quality-gate.sh:1615-1617`) and never reaches the export at `:1143`, so an exported `GATE_TEST_FOCUS` gets through
the same false claim in `docs/notes/agent-quality-gate-mechanics.md:1144` and the comment at `agent-quality-gate.test.sh:595-598`

a green gate run writes the whole-run success stamp (`agent-quality-gate.sh:5869-5877`); nothing in the gate reads `GATE_TEST_FOCUS`, so the focus isn't part of what that stamp covers ... the hook runs with `--skip-if-fresh` (`.trunk/trunk.yaml:136`), finds that stamp and skips all mapped commands. The result: a partial self-test certifies the push

Deleting the dispatch call makes the whole suite pass silently — the check after the end marker, around `agent-quality-gate.test.sh:510-518`: the check lets through zero or several dispatch calls, although the comment says "only the one dispatch call may run"
None of the new safety checks is tested. Nothing in the suite sets `GATE_TEST_FOCUS`; deleting the guard at `:600-604`, or any of the partition check's failure paths, would leave the suite green

judge_reasoning.3829986398: The review never mentions the abort trap expanding an unset output_file under set -u. It only confirms that the ERR trap fires correctly.
judge_reasoning.3829986403: Review item 2 says the check lets zero or several dispatch calls through and proposes counting dispatch lines and requiring exactly one in END.
judge_reasoning.3830003055: Review item 2 confirms by testing that deleting the dispatch call makes the suite exit 0 silently with no tests run.
judge_reasoning.3830042123: Review item 1 says the focus guard is bypassed with --no-lock / AGENT_QUALITY_GATE_LOCK=0, so a focused subset certifies the full gate.
judge_reasoning.3830042128: The review does not mention the hard-coded self-test path pin or the path-pin inventory.
judge_reasoning.3830695396: The review does not flag the doc wording 'is set' vs non-empty, or 'reds the suite'.

1.why: Verified: the guard at test.sh:600-604 checks only AGENT_QUALITY_GATE_LOCK_HELD/GITHUB_ACTIONS; gate.sh:1616-1617 returns early for gate_lock_enabled 0/false/no before the export at :1143, so a lock-free run lets an exported focus through. This is the known 'Reject focus during lock-free gate runs' item.

2.why: Docs line 1144 ('any command a real gate run spawns') and the comment at test.sh:595-598 state the refusal that claim 1 shows is incomplete. It's the same root defect as the known lock-free focus item, just described in the docs and comment.

3.why: Verified: gate.sh:5869-5877 writes the success stamp from current_stamp, the gate never reads GATE_TEST_FOCUS, and trunk.yaml:136 uses --skip-if-fresh, which exits before the lock. This is the downstream effect of the known lock-free focus defect, not a separate bug.

4.why: Verified: the awk body==2 branch (test.sh:510-518) only skips blank lines, comments and exact 'dispatch_gate_test_families' lines. It never requires the call to be present or unique, so deleting it defines the families, runs none, and exits 0. This matches the known 'Partition allows missing dispatch' item.

5.why: A grep of the repo finds no test that sets GATE_TEST_FOCUS, AGENT_QUALITY_GATE_LOCK_HELD+focus, or any bad partition layout. Only the definitions and docs mention them, so removing the guard at :600-604 or any fail_partition path would leave the suite green. Not covered by any known item.
